title: HSK 3.21 · 电视剧, 场合, 金牌, 长处
focus: 其次 · 热烈 · 相似 · 联合国 · 热爱 · 电视剧 · 场所 · 互联网 · 场合 · 合格 · 种子 · 裙子 · 牌子 · 电台 · 金牌 · 爱心 · 全场 · 价钱 · 古代 · 子女 · 剧场 · 被子 · 邮箱 · 表格 · 邮票 · 长城 · 电子邮件 · 现代化 · 话剧 · 沙子 · 代表团 · 影视 · 国庆 · 所长 · 票价 · 连续剧 · 长处 · 银牌 · 短处 · 京剧
body:
Shows, places and things with 子: 剧 "drama" runs through TV series, theatre and Beijing opera, 场 is a venue or occasion, and 牌 is a plaque, from brand signs to gold medals. Many nouns here end in a light 子 zi.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 剧 | jù | drama, play (刂 + 居 jū phonetic) | 电视剧, 剧场, 话剧, 连续剧, 京剧 |
| 场 | chǎng | venue, field; occasion (土 earth) | 场所, 场合, 全场, 剧场 |
| 子 | zi | noun suffix (light tone) | 种子, 裙子, 牌子, 被子, 沙子 |
| 牌 | pái | plaque, sign, brand (片 board) | 牌子, 金牌, 银牌 |
| 邮 | yóu | post, mail | 邮箱, 邮票, 电子邮件 |
| 电 | diàn | electricity | 电视剧, 电台, 电子邮件 |
| 代 | dài | era; replace, stand for | 古代, 现代化, 代表团 |
| 处 | chù | place, point | 长处, 短处 |

## Watch out

- 种子 is **zhǒng**zi (seed, kind); 种 reads zhòng when it means "to plant".
- 所长 is suǒ**zhǎng** (head of an institute); with the reading suǒcháng it means "one's strong point", like 长处 cháng.
- 被 (衤 clothing) vs 破 (石 stone): both have 皮 pí for sound.

cards.Example: 首先是价钱，其次是质量。 shǒuxiān shì jiàqian, qícì shì zhìliàng: price first, then quality
cards.Notes: 其 that, its + 次 order, next in line = next in order

cards.Example: 大家热烈欢迎他。 dàjiā rèliè huānyíng tā: everyone warmly welcomed him
cards.Notes: 热 hot + 烈 fierce (灬 fire + 列 liè phonetic) = fiery, enthusiastic

cards.Example: 这两个字很相似。 zhè liǎng ge zì hěn xiāngsì: these two characters look alike
cards.Notes: 相 mutual + 似 resemble (亻 person + 以 yǐ phonetic) = resemble each other

cards.Example: 他在联合国工作。 tā zài Liánhéguó gōngzuò: he works at the UN
cards.Notes: 联合 unite (联 link + 合 join) + 国 nations = United Nations

cards.Example: 我热爱音乐。 wǒ rè'ài yīnyuè: I love music
cards.Notes: 热 hot + 爱 love = passionately love

cards.Example: 我在看电视剧。 wǒ zài kàn diànshìjù: I'm watching a TV drama
cards.Notes: 电视 TV + 剧 drama = TV drama

cards.Example: 这里是公共场所。 zhèlǐ shì gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ: this is a public place
cards.Notes: 场 field, venue + 所 place = location, venue

cards.Example: 互联网很方便。 hùliánwǎng hěn fāngbiàn: the internet is convenient
cards.Notes: 互 mutual + 联 connect + 网 net = a net of mutual connections

cards.Example: 这种场合要穿正式。 zhè zhǒng chǎnghé yào chuān zhèngshì: dress formally for this occasion
cards.Notes: 场 scene + 合 fit, combine = the situation you're in

cards.Example: 产品都合格。 chǎnpǐn dōu hégé: all products pass
cards.Notes: 合 match + 格 standard, grid (木 + 各 gè phonetic) = meet the standard

cards.Example: 春天种种子。 chūntiān zhòng zhǒngzi: plant seeds in spring
cards.Notes: 种 seed, kind (禾 grain + 中 zhōng phonetic) + 子 suffix

cards.Example: 这条裙子很漂亮。 zhè tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang: this skirt is pretty
cards.Notes: 裙 = 衤 clothing + 君 jūn for the sound + 子 suffix

cards.Example: 这是什么牌子？ zhè shì shénme páizi: what brand is this?
cards.Notes: 牌 = 片 board + 卑 bēi for the sound: a signboard, so brand + 子 suffix

cards.Example: 我爱听这个电台。 wǒ ài tīng zhège diàntái: I love this radio station
cards.Notes: 电 electric + 台 station, platform = broadcasting station

cards.Example: 她拿了金牌。 tā ná le jīnpái: she won gold
cards.Notes: 金 gold + 牌 plaque = gold medal

cards.Example: 她很有爱心。 tā hěn yǒu àixīn: she's very caring
cards.Notes: 爱 love + 心 heart = a loving heart

cards.Example: 全场都站起来了。 quánchǎng dōu zhàn qǐlai le: the whole place stood up
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 场 venue = everyone present; also 'storewide'

cards.Example: 价钱太贵了。 jiàqian tài guì le: the price is too high
cards.Notes: 价 price (亻 + 介 jiè phonetic) + 钱 money; second syllable light

cards.Example: 古代没有电。 gǔdài méiyǒu diàn: there was no electricity in ancient times
cards.Notes: 古 ancient + 代 era, generation = ancient era

cards.Example: 他有三个子女。 tā yǒu sān ge zǐnǚ: he has three children
cards.Notes: 子 son + 女 daughter = children

cards.Example: 剧场里人很多。 jùchǎng li rén hěn duō: the theater is crowded
cards.Notes: 剧 drama + 场 venue = theater

cards.Example: 晚上盖好被子。 wǎnshang gài hǎo bèizi: tuck in your quilt at night
cards.Notes: 被 = 衤 clothing + 皮 pí for sound: a cover + 子 suffix; 被 is also the passive marker

cards.Example: 你的邮箱是什么？ nǐ de yóuxiāng shì shénme: what's your email?
cards.Notes: 邮 mail + 箱 box (竹 bamboo + 相 xiāng phonetic) = mailbox

cards.Example: 请填这张表格。 qǐng tián zhè zhāng biǎogé: please fill in this form
cards.Notes: 表 table, chart + 格 grid, box = a form with boxes

cards.Example: 他喜欢收集邮票。 tā xǐhuan shōují yóupiào: he collects stamps
cards.Notes: 邮 mail + 票 ticket = postage ticket, stamp

cards.Example: 我去过长城。 wǒ qù guo Chángchéng: I've been to the Great Wall
cards.Notes: 长 cháng long + 城 city wall (土 earth + 成 chéng phonetic) = long wall

cards.Example: 请发电子邮件。 qǐng fā diànzǐ yóujiàn: please send an email
cards.Notes: 电子 electronic + 邮件 mail item = email

cards.Example: 这个城市很现代化。 zhège chéngshì hěn xiàndàihuà: this city is very modern
cards.Notes: 现代 modern (现 present + 代 era) + 化 -ize = modernize

cards.Example: 我们去看话剧。 wǒmen qù kàn huàjù: let's go see a play
cards.Notes: 话 speech + 剧 drama = spoken drama (vs. sung opera)

cards.Example: 鞋里有沙子。 xié li yǒu shāzi: there's sand in my shoe
cards.Notes: 沙 = 氵 water + 少 little: tiny grains by the water + 子 suffix

cards.Example: 代表团明天到。 dàibiǎotuán míngtiān dào: the delegation arrives tomorrow
cards.Notes: 代表 represent (代 stand in + 表 show) + 团 group = delegation

cards.Example: 她学影视专业。 tā xué yǐngshì zhuānyè: she studies film and TV
cards.Notes: 影 film (电影) + 视 TV (电视) = film and TV

cards.Example: 国庆放七天假。 Guóqìng fàng qī tiān jià: National Day is a week off
cards.Notes: 国 nation + 庆 celebrate = National Day (Oct 1)

cards.Meaning: head of an institute or station
cards.Example: 所长在开会。 suǒzhǎng zài kāihuì: the director is in a meeting
cards.Notes: 所 office, institute + 长 zhǎng head = director; as suǒcháng it means one's forte

cards.Example: 票价多少钱？ piàojià duōshao qián: how much is a ticket?
cards.Notes: 票 ticket + 价 price = ticket price

cards.Example: 这部连续剧很长。 zhè bù liánxùjù hěn cháng: this series is long
cards.Notes: 连续 continuous (连 connect + 续 continue) + 剧 drama = serial

cards.Example: 每个人都有长处。 měi ge rén dōu yǒu chángchù: everyone has strengths
cards.Notes: 长 cháng long, excel + 处 point, place = where one excels

cards.Example: 他得了银牌。 tā dé le yínpái: he got silver
cards.Notes: 银 silver (钅 metal + 艮 phonetic) + 牌 plaque = silver medal

cards.Example: 别只看别人的短处。 bié zhǐ kàn biérén de duǎnchù: don't just see others' flaws
cards.Notes: 短 short, lacking + 处 point = where one falls short; mirror of 长处

cards.Example: 爷爷爱听京剧。 yéye ài tīng Jīngjù: grandpa loves Beijing opera
cards.Notes: 京 capital (Beijing) + 剧 drama = Beijing opera
